Strip any data-URI prefix and whitespace,\n// drop padding, then: bytes = floor(charsWithoutPadding * 3 / 4).\ndef base64ByteSize = { content ->\n    if (!content) return 0L\n    def s = content.toString().trim()\n\n    // strip a \"data:<mime>;base64,\" prefix if present\n    def idx = s.indexOf(\"base64,\")\n    if (idx >= 0) s = s.substring(idx + \"base64,\".length())\n\n    // remove whitespace/newlines that some encoders insert\n    s = s.replaceAll(/\\s/, \"\")\n\n    // remove padding characters\n    def noPad = s.replaceAll(/=+$/, \"\")\n    if (!noPad) return 0L\n\n    return ((noPad.length() as long) * 3L).intdiv(4L)\n}\n\n// --- Extract fileType from mimeType (several mimeTypes map to a single fileType) ---\ndef extractFileType = { String mime ->\n    if (!mime) \"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slideshow\"       : \"PPTX\",\n        \"application/vnd.ms-powerpoint.presentation.macroenabled.12\"                   : \"PPTX\",\n   : \"DOCX\",\n        \"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.template\"      : \"DOCX\",\n        \"application/vnd.ms-word.document.macroenabled.12\"                             : \"DOCX\",\n\n        // HTML\n        \"text/html\"                                                                    : \"HTML\",\n        \"application/xhtml+xml\"                                                        : \"HTML\"\n    ]\n\n    def type = mimeMap[m]\n    if (type) return type\n\n    // Fallback: keyword-based detection for unlisted variants\n    if (m.contains(\"pdf\"))                                        return \"PDF\"\n    if (m.contains(\"spreadsheet\") || m.contains(\"excel\"))         return \"XLSX\"\n    if (m.contains(\"presentation\") || m.contains(\"powerpoint\"))   return \"PPTX\"\n    if (m.contains(\"word\"))                                       return \"DOCX\"\n    if (m.contains(\"html\") || m.contains(\"xhtml\"))                return \"HTML\"\n    return \"PDF\" // default\n}\n\n// --- Map fileType -> canvasType ---\ndef resolveCanvasType = { String type ->\n    switch (type) {\n        case [\"PDF\", \"DOCX\", \"PPTX\"]: return \"pdf_viewer\"\n        case \"XLSX\":                  return \"sheet_viewer\"\n        case \"HTML\":                  return \"iframe\"\n        default:                      return \"e_interface\"\n    }\n}\n\n// --- Format count as a string with the unit appropriate to the file type ---\n// PDF/DOCX -> pages, PPTX -> slides, XLSX -> sheets. Handles singular/plural.\ndef formatCount = { c, String type ->\n    if (type == \"HTML\") return \"\"\n\n    def n = (c ?: 0) as long\n    def unit\n    switch (type) {\n        case [\"PDF\", \"DOCX\"]: unit = \"page\";  break\n        case \"PPTX\":          unit = \"slide\"; break\n        case \"XLSX\":          unit = \"sheet\"; break\n        default:              unit = \"page\";  break\n    }\n    def label = (n == 1L) ? unit : (unit+'s').toString()\n    return \"$n $label\"\n}\n\n// --- Convert bytes to a human-readable size string (Kb, Mb, Gb) ---\ndef formatFileSize = { size ->\n    def bytes = (size ?: 0) as long\n    if (bytes < 1024)                return \"$bytes B\"\n    if (bytes < 1024L * 1024)        return String.format(\"%.2f KB\", bytes / 1024.0)\n    if (bytes < 1024L * 1024 * 1024) return String.format(\"%.2f MB\", bytes / (1024.0 * 1024))\n    return String.format(\"%.2f GB\", bytes / (1024.0 * 1024 * 1024))\n}\n\ndef fileType = extractFileType(mimeType)\ndef canvasType = resolveCanvasType(fileType)\ndef countLabel = formatCount(count, fileType)\n\n// prefer the base64-derived size; fall back to an explicit fileSize if no content\ndef sizeBytes = base64ByteSize(fileContent)\nif (sizeBytes <= 0) sizeBytes = (fileSizeFallback ?: 0) as long\ndef readableFileSize = formatFileSize(sizeBytes)\n\nreturn [\n    pageInputs: [\n        \"title\"      : title,\n        \"description\": description,\n        \"count\"      : countLabel.toString(),// string, e.g. \"3 pages\" / \"1 page\" / \"5 slides\" / \"2 sheets\"\n        \"previewUrl\" : previewUrl,\n        \"downloadUrl\": downloadUrl,\n        \"fileType\"   : fileType,          // \"XLSX\" | \"PPTX\" | \"DOCX\" | \"PDF\" | \"HTML\"\n        \"fileSize\"   : readableFileSize,  // human-readable string, e.g. \"228.85 Kb\"\n        \"canvasType\" : canvasType         // \"pdf_viewer\" | \"sheet_viewer\" | \"e_interface\"\n    ],\n    \"fileType\"  : fileType,\n    \"canvasType\": canvasType,\n    \"title\"     : title\n]",

unit : (unit+'s').toString()\n    return \"$n $label\"\n}\n\n// --- Convert bytes to a human-readable size string (Kb, Mb, Gb) ---\ndef formatFileSize = { size ->\n    def bytes = (size ?: 0) as long\n    if (bytes < 1024)                return \"$bytes B\"\n    if (bytes < 1024L * 1024)        return String.format(\"%.2f KB\", bytes / 1024.0)\n    if (bytes < 1024L * 1024 * 1024) return String.format(\"%.2f MB\", bytes / (1024.0 * 1024))\n    return String.format(\"%.2f GB\", bytes / (1024.0 * 1024 * 1024))\n}\n\ndef fileType = extractFileType(mimeType)\ndef canvasType = resolveCanvasType(fileType)\ndef countLabel = formatCount(count, fileType)\n\n// prefer the base64-derived size; fall back to an explicit fileSize if no content\ndef sizeBytes = base64ByteSize(fileContent)\nif (sizeBytes <= 0) sizeBytes = (fileSizeFallback ?: 0) as long\ndef readableFileSize = formatFileSize(sizeBytes)\n\nreturn [\n    pageInputs: [\n        \"artifactId\"   : canvasId,\n        \"title\"      : title,\n        \"description\": description,\n        \"count\"      : countLabel.toString(),// string, e.g. \"3 pages\" / \"1 page\" / \"5 slides\" / \"2 sheets\"\n        \"previewUrl\" : previewUrl,\n        \"downloadUrl\": downloadUrl,\n        \"fileType\"   : fileType,          // \"XLSX\" | \"PPTX\" | \"DOCX\" | \"PDF\" | \"HTML\"\n        \"fileSize\"   : readableFileSize,  // human-readable string, e.g. \"228.85 Kb\"\n        \"canvasType\" : canvasType         // \"pdf_viewer\" | \"sheet_viewer\" | \"e_interface\"\n    ],\n    \"fileType\"  : fileType,\n    \"canvasType\": canvasType,\n    \"title\"     : title\n]",
